union_categoricals_basic: union two categorical arrays with the same dtype and return a combined categorical
union_categoricals_sorted: union two categorical arrays with sort_categories=True to sort the resulting categories alphabetically
union_categoricals_ignore_order: union ordered and unordered categorical arrays using ignore_order=True to bypass order mismatch
union_categoricals_nan: union categorical arrays containing NaN values across different category dtypes
union_categoricals_unwrap: union categorical arrays wrapped in Series or CategoricalIndex by unwrapping to raw categoricals
